purpose: User requested a larger-context retrieval supplement on 2026-10-13; no new model calls or feature generations.
questions: The same frozen 20 questions; preserve dev/test and Q19 exclusion. No new gold or score changes.
unchanged_parameters: Same corpus/chunks/index/query vectors; BM25 k1=1.5 b=0.75; hybrid depth20 RRF60; Basic k10 actual display order; Local source0.5 community0.15 entity10 relationship10 level2; same whole-row tail trim and common o200k budget.
original_results: Do not overwrite original contexts, scores or execution ledger. Add a separate budget-supplement directory.

additional_descriptive_metrics.context_length: Report actual final tokens and source-only tokens; table and metadata tokens count toward the common cap.
additional_descriptive_metrics.duplicate_source_lines: Repeated (path,line) occurrences across returned source chunks divided by all returned source-line occurrences; empty context gives null. Also record duplicate text-unit IDs.
additional_descriptive_metrics.unjudged_source_lines: Unique returned source lines outside the union of frozen necessary evidence spans divided by unique returned source lines. This is unjudged material, NOT a noise/irrelevance rate; Q19 has no gold and is excluded from its aggregate.
additional_descriptive_metrics.qualitative_scope: Inspect pre-existing cases Q01, Q07, Q13, Q20 at 16000 for missing evidence and useful/nonessential material; no gold edits or overall noise estimate.

interpretation: A budget sensitivity check of this fixed pipeline, not a new independent test set or causal graph ablation. Basic may plateau at k10; Local source fractions and whole chunks may leave unused capacity. Keep extraction-format anomalies disclosed.
